title: r4subrepro: Reproducibility and Reviewability Indicators
text: r4subrepro scores computational reproducibility reviewer readiness R based regulatory submission. statically inspects analysis code folder asks questions reviewer asks trying re-run anything: can environment reinstalled, paths work machine, one obvious script run, hidden setup assumptions, packages declared, proof clean run, code readable. Results emitted standard R4SUB evidence rows (indicator_domain = "usability") via r4subcore, flow straight Submission Confidence Index alongside reviewer-experience indicators r4subscore r4subprofile.

title: Default Reproducibility Assessment Configuration — repro_config_default
text: list class "repro_config" following elements: max_script_depth Maximum recommended brace nesting depth script flagged (integer). entry_point_names Character vector file names count single obvious entry point. lockfile_names Character vector file names patterns count captured package environment. run_evidence_patterns Character vector regular expressions match clean run log sessionInfo() capture. expected_output_dir Name subfolder holds submitted outputs execution check reproduce (character). run_timeout Maximum seconds allow reproduction run (integer). cosmetic_output_ext Character vector output file extensions (rtf pdf) whose embedded timestamps stripped comparison, output differs generation time counts analytically reproduced rather mismatch. compiled_source_ext Character vector file extensions mark compiled native source reviewer must build (C, C++, Fortran). compiled_call_patterns Character vector regular expressions inline compilation calls (sourceCpp, cppFunction, R CMD SHLIB). compiled_build_files Character vector build-script file names (Makevars, Makevars.win) indicate native compilation. toolchain_doc_pattern Regular expression matches documentation compiler toolchain (Rtools) reviewers need build source. verification_patterns Character vector regular expressions match independent-verification artifact, SAS vs R comparison QC report. windows_risk_patterns Named character vector regular expressions non-portable constructs can break Windows reviewer machine (shell-outs, forking, POSIX paths). adrg_names Character vector patterns matching Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide document file name. adrg_required_sections Named character vector regular expressions sections ADRG contain. weights Named list relative indicator weights summing 1: env_lockfile, path_hygiene, entry_point, hidden_setup, proprietary_pkgs, clean_run, script_depth, output_reproduction, dual_verification, adrg, windows_reviewability, compiled_toolchain.

title: r4subrepro 0.4.0
text: Adds assess_compiled_toolchain() (R-REPRO-012), detects whether submission compiles native code (C/C++/Fortran source, src/ folder, Makevars script, inline sourceCpp()/cppFunction()/R CMD SHLIB call) , , checks Rtools toolchain reviewers need build Windows documented. CRAN packages install prebuilt Windows binaries, submission without local compilation passes. assess_proprietary_pkgs() (R-REPRO-005) now tiers referenced packages reproducible source instead binary known/unknown split: CRAN known packages pass, non-CRAN packages declared GitHub/Git/URL/ local source warn (bundle sources), undeclared proprietary packages warn medium severity. Renamed “Package Reproducibility Tiering”. assess_output_reproduction() (R-REPRO-008) now separates analytical content cosmetic bytes: data outputs must match exactly, rtf pdf outputs compared embedded generation timestamps stripped, output differs generation time counts reproduced rather false mismatch. Reweights indicator set include compiled-code toolchain check.

title: r4subrepro 0.3.0
text: Adds assess_windows_reviewability() (R-REPRO-011), static check non-portable constructs can break Windows reviewer machine (shell-outs, forking, POSIX paths). Windows FDA reviewer environment. assess_output_reproduction() (R-REPRO-008) now records operating system re-run happened warns Windows, since outputs must reproduce reviewer’s Windows machine. Reweights indicator set include Windows reviewability. assess_env_lockfile() (R-REPRO-001) now grades lockfile quality instead mere presence: version-pinned renv.lock packrat lockfile passes, renv.lock stub versions DESCRIPTION-dependency list warns, nothing fails. top-level dependency list version-pinned lockfile. adrg_skeleton() now generates Executive Summary (overview analysis programs purpose), Troubleshooting section (path, package install, Rtools/compiled, R-version, proprietary-package failure modes), analysis-type (primary/secondary) column program table. assess_adrg() requires executive summary troubleshooting sections.

title: r4subrepro 0.2.0
text: Adds assess_output_reproduction() (R-REPRO-008), re-runs submission’s entry point fresh, sandboxed R session checks outputs match submitted outputs byte byte. Execution opt-never touches submission folder; without run = TRUE indicator returns na. assess_reproducibility() gains include_execution append output-reproduction check. Adds assess_dual_verification() (R-REPRO-009), checks submission declares independent verification results, SAS versus R comparison QC report, assess_sas_r_concordance(), compares two result tables cell cell within tolerance. static check included assess_reproducibility(). Adds assess_adrg() (R-REPRO-010), checks submission includes Analysis Data Reviewer’s Guide covering required inputs, run order, expected outputs, R packages, environment setup, adrg_skeleton(), generates draft standard PHUSE / R Consortium ADRG structure (sections 1 8 plus R execution appendix), auto-filling analysis datasets, analysis output programs program--output traceability table, proprietary open-source R package split versions, execution steps, adding Reproducibility Verification section base template omits. check included assess_reproducibility(). Reweights indicator set accommodate new reproducibility, verification, reviewer-guide indicators.

title: r4subrepro 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Adds seven static reproducibility reviewability indicators submission’s analysis code folder, following guidance making R submissions reviewable regulators: environment lockfile present (R-REPRO-001), path hygiene (R-REPRO-002), single entry point (R-REPRO-003), hidden setup assumptions (R-REPRO-004), proprietary package declaration (R-REPRO-005), clean run evidence (R-REPRO-006), script complexity (R-REPRO-007). assess_reproducibility() runs seven returns combined R4SUB evidence table indicator_domain = "usability", results flow Submission Confidence Index. reproducibility_summary() gives weighted overall score readable print method.
